lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately 10 visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. These clusters maintain regular spacing along the mid-lateral line, forming a rectilinear geometric grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity run perpendicular to the longitudinal axis, with the high-luminance blobs positioned centrally at the intersections of these bands and the horizontal carinae.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the lateral flank. The most prominent ridge exhibits a sharp vertical luminance gradient (white/light upper edge, dark/shadow lower edge) and runs horizontally from the fifth gill slit toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 12 high-luminance spots of varying diameters, primarily concentrated in the anterior and medial regions of the fin's surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of smaller high-luminance spots along the leading edge, distinct from the larger grid-patterned blobs on the primary trunk.
